extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors attempting to create a new article / editors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who want to create a new Wikipedia page: how to check whether an article exists, account and confirmation requirements, alternatives (article wizard/draft requests), and troubleshooting (caching, title capitalization, deletions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for existing or alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for [title] in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search for "Logan Paul suicide forest" in existing articles. Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create the page; consider logging in and meeting autoconfirmation requirements first.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or submit a draft / request new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack permission or are unsure, the article wizard or a draft/request process is an alternative path to creating content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for propagation / caching delays after recent creation
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you just created the page and don't see it, either wait or use the purge function to refresh database visibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization variants when searching and consider creating redirects from alternate capitalizations to the canonical title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if page may have been removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate the deletion log to determine if the article was previously deleted and why, before attempting recreation.
